hard_constraints: Single POV: Ben Skywalker throughout; no head-hopping or ensemble omniscient.

Force mechanics per Legends: light/dark moral polarity preserved; wounds cause unreliable sense, emotional amplification, dark residue bleed (e.g., Malachor V precedent); no World Between Worlds or kyber bleeding.

Terminology: 'the Weave' lowercase unless sentence-start; rotate metaphors (no 'handrail in the dark', 'reached for the Force'); use structural-absence register for Torin's void (deliberate, directional unweaving).
Torin diminishment: subtraction (warmth, humor, affection idioms absent), not dark-side corruption spectacle (no altered eyes/voice sinisterly); voice articulate, emotionally hollow.
Style: Capitalize 'Human'; 'Jedi' singular/plural (no 'Jedis'); 'Darth' capitalized before name; American English; no ABY/BBY in prose.
No anachronisms: blaster not gun, datapad not laptop, etc.
legends_continuity_notes: 47 ABY post-Fate of the Jedi: Ben Skywalker ~21, experienced Jedi Knight (GAG service, Abeloth defeat); Jedi Order at Coruscant Temple under Luke.
Force wounds (Nathema, Malachor V): persistent, disorienting, amplify extremes/moral unreliability without removing abilities; matches scene's unweaving (formless pressure, no light/dark texture).
Ruusan Reformations (1000 BBY Legends canon): post-NEW Sith Wars restructuring; AU layer (penance for technique) authorized but public history unchanged.
required_context_for_drafter: Setting: Veranthos Scar (3m vertical distortion like heat shimmer); Torin's void: sharp boundary, Weave absent, formless Force hunger.

Key beats: Torin hands on Scar (eyes open/unseeing, Scar narrows); Sera screams name, shakes off Ben, enters void (presence flares); her line: 'I was sealed once. I will not watch it happen to someone else and do nothing.'
Torin voice: precise sentences, no warmth/humor/affection; 'caldera does not consume, replaces' fulfills Maetha's Ch12 warning (PP05 payoff).
Ben reaction: horror as subtraction via Force (warmth absence); isolated across valley post-Sera entry.
Sensory: structured-absence (void as unpicked Weave, suction/drain); emotional arc horror -> Sera determination -> Ben braced isolation.
Present: Ben, Sera, Kael, Torin; Desh off-stage (Ch25 nodes).
allowed_au_divergences: Battle of Veranthos, forbidden technique (Gavran's unweaving), Wound/Scar at vergence.
Survivors as anchors: Torin Hal (Battle Master, technique user), Sera Varik (Gavran lieutenant).
Maetha's warning ('caldera replaces you'), Weave-Resonance not yet (Ch26 s3).
Torin diminishment/corruption arc consequence: technique replacement, not Legends death.
